title: hieracium brachiatum subsp. villarsii
intro: Hieracium brachiatum subsp. villarsii, commonly known as False Hawkweed, is a type of flowering plant in the dandelion family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation in the body. The therapeutic actions of Hieracium brachiatum subsp. villarsii include wound healing, antimicrobial, and antifungal activities, making it useful for treating various skin conditions and infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
